CreateScheduledMessageRequest.title: CreateScheduledMessageRequest
CreateScheduledMessageRequest.description: POST /channels/{channel_id}/messages/scheduled, user Bearer sessions only. New scheduled_at must be 1 minute..30 days ahead of the server clock. Quotas are 100 active intents per author and 25 per channel, including preparing/dispatching reservations; exhaustion returns 409/50035. Same author/request_id and original normalized request returns the current schedule (including terminal states) before rechecking time or current send access; different original content/channel conflicts. An incomplete acceptance returns 503, never a falsely accepted pending job.

EditScheduledMessageRequest.title: EditScheduledMessageRequest
EditScheduledMessageRequest.description: PATCH a pending schedule. The expected revision must match; at least one replacement is required. message replaces the whole draft, not individual fields. A new scheduled_at must be 1 minute..30 days ahead of the server clock. Fresh Standard send access is required; already-dispatching or terminal jobs conflict.

ScheduledMessage.title: ScheduledMessage
ScheduledMessage.description: Author-private durable schedule. A sent outcome certifies storage, not event/push delivery. An unknown outcome may have stored a message; its selected ID is not proof of delivery. Terminal/unknown states clear the draft and release active quota exactly once. Only the original dispatch attempt may later certify unknown as sent; automatic redispatch is forbidden. Pre-dispatch dependency retries expire after 24 hours overdue. Unresolved dispatches become eligible for unknown recovery after 2 minutes; this is not a deadline during an outage.

ScheduledMessageDraft.title: ScheduledMessageDraft
ScheduledMessageDraft.description: Initial scheduling surface: Standard text, optional TTS/reply and reply-ping/silent options. Full replacement when edited. Attachment, embed, component and forward drafts are unsupported and must not be silently dropped. Normal send permissions and mention policy are re-evaluated at dispatch.

tts.description: Requires SEND_TTS_MESSAGES at acceptance/edit and dispatch.

reply_to.description: Same-channel reply target, revalidated at dispatch.

replied_user.description: Whether a reply mentions its target author; ignored when reply_to is absent.

silent.description: Maps to SUPPRESS_NOTIFICATIONS (4096), with the existing silent-message semantics.

ScheduledMessageId.title: ScheduledMessageId
ScheduledMessageId.description: Client-generated cryptographically random lowercase UUIDv4. The author/key pair identifies one durable schedule intent across channels. Preserve and replay the exact original request after response loss.

ScheduledMessageList.title: ScheduledMessageList
ScheduledMessageList.description: Author/channel page in schedule UUID order, including active/unknown jobs and terminal jobs from the last seven days. Follow non-null next_after even after an empty page filtered by journal state. Exact author lookup retains content-free idempotency records after list expiry.

ScheduledMessageRevision.title: ScheduledMessageRevision
ScheduledMessageRevision.description: Monotonic schedule revision. Compare only within the same author/schedule; unrelated to read-state versions or gateway sequence. Mutation fails closed at exhaustion.

Snowflake.title: Snowflake
Snowflake.description: A 64-bit Discordy Snowflake ID serialized as a decimal string (42 bits ms since 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, 10 bits worker, 12 bits sequence).
